item.title: Experts Oppose Recruiting Foreign Housemen, Say 47% Shortage Not Critical
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)

Arshil says MOs should be the focus, while Arasu says the shortage isn’t at a crisis level to justify importing HOs.
